title: Slow checkout
summary: Checkout takes seconds while product pages stay fast, and the API is barely using its CPU.
alert: [FIRING] CheckoutSlow: p95 of POST /api/orders is above 1 s

questions.prompt: What is checkout spending its time waiting for?

choices.label: DNS lookups of TaxRate's host name
The event loop, blocked by JavaScript

questions.prompt: Why do those waits pile up instead of running in parallel?

choices.label: They run on libuv's thread pool, where only a couple can run at once
JavaScript is single-threaded, so they run one at a time
The container runs out of ephemeral ports
The database pool only has 10 connections

questions.prompt: Why does the API need TaxRate's address so often?

choices.label: Every quote opens a new connection instead of reusing one
TaxRate's DNS records have a very short TTL
Failed quotes are retried several times
The API asks for one quote per line item
A health check resolves TaxRate every second
